title: The Arabic Origins of Cryptology, Book One: al-Kindi’s Treatise on Cryptanalysis
lineage: Inspected the identified passages; retained file is a paraphrased research note.

passages.note: English translation of the edited treatise identifies Ayasofya 4832 folios 211–216 and describes a letter-frequency method; it identifies al-Kindi as author. Composition date and surviving copy are distinct.
